criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Geographical/Administrative Containment
categories.definition: The first entity is physically situated within, or is an administrative division of, the second entity.

categories.name: Organizational Membership
categories.definition: The first entity is part of, or officially associated with, the second entity, which is an organized group, institution, or competition.

categories.name: Creator and Creation
categories.definition: One entity is the individual or organization responsible for originating or producing the other entity, which is a specific work, product, or design.

categories.name: Role/Title/Occupation
categories.definition: The first entity possesses a specific professional title or role, or is categorized by the occupation described by the second entity.

categories.name: Event Participation
categories.definition: The first entity takes part in the second entity, which is a specific event, competition, or historical occurrence.

categories.name: Classification/Type/Genre
categories.definition: The first entity is a subcategory, genre, or specific classification within the broader category of the second entity.

categories.name: Family Relation
categories.definition: The first and second entities are related by blood, marriage, or adoption.

categories.name: Award/Nomination
categories.definition: The first entity was recognized with or considered for the second entity, which is an honor or prize.

categories.name: Language
categories.definition: The first entity specifies the language used for the second entity.

categories.name: Musical Instrumentalist
categories.definition: The first entity is an individual whose primary musical role involves playing the second entity, a musical instrument.

categories.name: Political Affiliation
categories.definition: The first entity is officially associated with the second entity, which is a political party.

categories.name: Political Entity Leadership
categories.definition: The first entity holds the highest position of authority within the second entity, which is a political or governmental body.

categories.name: Nationality/Origin
categories.definition: The first entity's national identity or place of origin is specified by the second entity.

categories.name: Predecessor/Successor
categories.definition: The first entity is an earlier or later version, model, or iteration in a sequence related to the second entity.

categories.name: Source/Inspiration
categories.definition: The first entity draws its creative or conceptual foundation from the second entity.

categories.name: Jurisdiction
categories.definition: The first entity has legal authority or control over the second entity.

categories.name: Art Movement Affiliation
categories.definition: The first entity is an artist or work connected to the second entity, which is a recognized art movement or style.

categories.name: Concept/Discovery
categories.definition: The first entity is a scientific concept, theory, or discovery attributed to the second entity.

categories.name: Issued By
categories.definition: The first entity is an official document or item provided by the second entity.

categories.name: Platform
categories.definition: The first entity is a software or hardware environment that supports or hosts the second entity.

categories.name: Character/Part of Work
categories.definition: The first entity is a fictional character or a distinct component that exists within the second entity, which is a larger creative work.

categories.name: Ownership/Management
categories.definition: The first entity owns, manages, publishes, or distributes the second entity.
